Under daytype.friday_exit_close_location_over_flow_shape's (volume, net) pair that is a HANDOVER THAT CONTINUES, not a flowless unpriced print. UP. EXPIRY FORM. 0626 is NGN26 last trade day. structure.mature_swing_alternation.s101_6_expiry_day_form splits on stranded premium: with it, unwind; without it, alternation plus short-covering into the settle governs and you NEVER short an expiry session on the sponsor-expires argument. So the covering-into-settle branch governs, base band +300..+700 (n=2: 0225 +420, 0327 +1160). CRITICAL HAIRCUT: both precedents had the walked leg AS the expiring contract. Mine does not - the scored leg is NGQ26 and the expiry mechanics live in NGN26. NGQ26 receives spillover only (residual roll bid, and it inherits the prompt role at the settle), so I take roughly 0.4 of the band, ~+200, and say so rather than banking a precedent that does not structurally apply. MAGNITUDE CEILING. flow.price_free_absorption_proxy fires on its stated precondition (session signed flow POSITIVE at +1956; big-print sample 122, guard-clean well above the 20-print floor of flow.big_print_bshare_thin_tape_guard, so the bar stands unraised). Its reading is the constraint: big_print_b_share (size-weighted) is 0.499 and does NOT clear the measured 0.547 flip bar, so the absorber has NOT left - buy-absorption-failing risk is live and the play's instruction is TAKE THE TURN SMALL. This is the only price-free instrument in the slot flow_conviction cannot fill blind, and it caps me. COMPONENTS, all derived: expiry covering-into-settle on the deferred leg +200; young-leg aligned-flow continuation at ~0.2x n0_net_sigma_5 (589) in a quiet regime (n0_range_pctile 18.3) +120; against it, weekend and holiday-truncated-week squaring plus contango carry plus a bearish physical stack -70. Net +250, about 0.4 sigma. GAP. 0625->0626 is an INTRA-WEEK boundary; 24 of 24 intra-week boundaries measured across G19+G20+G21 carry |gap| <= 10, so the overnight is structurally zero and I emit 0. SHAPE. Early softness (weekend squaring, weak cash, the -0.5 CDD run cut), firm through the middle on the residual roll and expiry bid, then flat-to-lower into the close as the weekend bag is set - the 0225 form (morning trough, covering leg, close off the high), damped for the deferred leg. TIMING CAVEAT: the phase table is session-relative and carries no clock boundaries, so this shape is a derived expectation, NOT a phase-to-clock mapping. WHAT I AM TRADING AGAINST, honestly: the fundamental stack is bearish and I am up against it. Surplus vs 5yr 112 in injection phase; the 06-25 print was 76 Bcf against a strictly-pre-print consensus of 67, a +9 Bcf BEARISH miss at decision time (the served +2.0 uses the post-print-frozen 74 and must be discounted per the auditor); the next consensus is 81, a bigger build still; curve in contango; cash basis -0.139 with chg_3d -0.212, i.e. physical July collapsing against futures in the middle of bidweek; and forecast_run_delta_cdd is -0.5, today's model run CUTTING cooling demand. That stack is why the number is +250 and not +500, and why confidence is low rather than medium. The sign still follows the state because my own self-analysis found that emitting a Friday sign from the day-class default rather than the state owned 72% of my misses, and the bearish stack here is a PRIOR, while the aligned D-1 handover tape and the clean gate are STATE.
